svg.title: Bits per texel vs Oodle Texture 2.9.16
svg.desc: Per format and Oodle λ on Kodak, mipple's Zstd-19 bits per texel at Oodle's RMSE and at its SSIM against Oodle's own blocks under Zstd-19.
svg.text: Bits per texel vs Oodle Texture 2.9.16, same back end
Kodak (24 images). Oodle's blocks from a stock Unreal Engine 5.8 cook; mipple at Oodle's RMSE and SSIM; all Zstd-19. Lower is better.
